title: Mealime Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mealime:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often mealime metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on mealime metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you how often your mealime metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
